title: myPip
description_en: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI. MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

title: 1Password for Agents
description_en: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords. 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

title: FLUX 3 Max
description_en: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds. FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

title: Cloudflare Clairic
description_en: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction. Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

title: AgentValley
description_en: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch. It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

title: Context Engine
description_en: One memory for your AI agents and human team members.. Context Engine is one memory for your AI agents and your team. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code save to it as they work, and the people on your team read it, ask it questions and add files. Free to start.

title: LinkIntel
description_en: Post insights delivered direct to your AI. Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

title: Polylane for Cloudflare
description_en: An AI on-call engineer for your Cloudflare apps. Polylane catches issues across your Cloudflare apps, follows the connections between Workers, databases, queues and storage, and investigates the root cause using your code, logs and recent changes. When the fix is in your code, it opens a pull request for review. Connect with one read-only Cloudflare token.

title: Monish
description_en: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen. Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

title: Instant Search
description_en: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files.. Instant is the first accurate local AI file search that uses the latest embedding models to find the exact file (and page) with the content you’re looking for with a 95% hit rate.

title: Plango
description_en: Use AI to defend against AI. Secure your Mac while building with AI. Plango monitors AI coding agents, protects sensitive files and secrets, blocks suspicious network activity, scans projects for vulnerabilities, and gives you control over what your agents can access. Powered by an on-device AI security model. Private by default.

title: Inyon
description_en: Answer your coding agents from your phone. Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

title: Dots
description_en: A customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Dots goes further by helping you access your favorite apps, websites, and shortcuts without constantly switching windows. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

title: Canva Craft
description_en: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit. Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

title: Peras
description_en: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week. Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

title: Termi Protocol
description_en: Watch AI agents code in 3D and hand off the work. Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

title: sideOS.ai
description_en: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more. sideOS lives in your Mac’s notch. Hold Control + Option, say what you want, let go! It reads your screen, opens apps, clicks, types and tells you when it’s done. Run it fully offline local models or use your own Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok key.

title: DotMD
description_en: Review your AI agent's Markdown specs like a pull request. Your AI agents write the specs, plans and docs. DotMD is a native Mac Markdown app where you review them like a pull request: comment on exact lines, the agent fixes them over MCP, and you accept every change. Also a fast reader and editor: Mermaid, math, code, version history, search, PDF export. Everything stays on your Mac. Free to read.

title: Dots Phone
description_en: A phone-calling plugin for OpenAI Dots. Dots Phone is an independent plugin for OpenAI Dots. Give Dots a phone task: it prepares a brief, makes the call, asks Codex for missing details when needed, and reports the result. Self-hosted with your OpenAI and Twilio accounts.

title: Bloblings
description_en: A pet for every Claude Code session. Every Claude Code and Codex thread gets a pet that acts out its work and shows when it needs you. One click opens the thread. Threads pass notes and work as a team, and you see every one. Free, native, and nothing leaves your Mac.

title: Gerty
description_en: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac. Gerty is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your Mac. It measures your Mac, picks the best open models for each job (chat, writing, code, understanding and making pictures), downloads them and sets them up as one assistant. No terminal, no setup. It works with your documents, mail and calendar, you can ask it out loud, and it shows you every change before it makes it. No account, no cloud, works offline. CHF 49 once for 3 Macs, 7-day free trial.

title: Basedash Scheduled CSV Exports
description_en: Ask once. Get a fresh CSV in Slack or email every week.. Basedash automations can now send CSV exports. Write it into the instructions — "send a CSV of last week's new signups every Monday" — and each run builds the file from your data. In Slack, the CSV is attached in the message's thread; emails and the automation's run history get a Download CSV link. Downloads go through Basedash, so recipients need access to the automation to open them. Ask for it once. Get the CSV every week.

title: kosa8
description_en: Secure sandboxes with an undo button for AI agents.. Kosa8 lets you run AI agents inside secure, isolated virtual machines without risking your own computer. Give Claude Code, Codex, or other agents their own sandbox, restrict what they can access, and checkpoint the entire running environment before risky changes. If something breaks, rewind in about a second — even running processes are restored. You can also fork environments to test multiple approaches in parallel, run local AI models, and manage everything from one dashboard.

title: Fluxix
description_en: Control what your AI agents can access, run, and spend. AI agents can call APIs, access databases, and move money. But one wrong action can cause serious damage. Fluxix puts a safety layer between your agents and your systems, checking every action before it happens. Set rules in plain English, block risky operations, require human approval, and protect sensitive data. Every decision is logged, so you stay in control without slowing your agents down.

title: Otter Hire
description_en: Modern AI ATS to Recruit & Hire - Unlimited Everything. Otter is a modern, AI-powered ATS that makes recruiting calm, fast, and simple. Manage jobs, candidates, applications, interviews, and scorecards in one place. Turn emailed resumes into candidate profiles with AI resume parsing, build your careers page, track your hiring pipeline, and get actionable reports. Integrate with your workflows using our API and MCP server. One flat price per workspace, with unlimited users and candidates. Start your 14-day free trial - no credit card required.

title: Surveys in Claude and ChatGPT
description_en: Build surveys in Claude and ChatGPT, keep answers private. Connect BlockSurvey to Claude, Claude Code or ChatGPT. Describe the survey you need and get a live link back in the same chat. Change questions by asking. Responses stay end-to-end encrypted, so your AI assistant never sees them.

title: Daily Simmer
description_en: Save any recipe, make it yours, then plan, shop and cook. Paste a recipe link or an Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or YouTube post and get a clean recipe with ingredients, steps, servings and a link to its source. Snap a recipe card or start from an idea. Ask the AI sous chef for a swap and approve every change before it saves. Moving from Paprika, CookBook, Flavorish, Mr. Cook or Recipe Keeper? Bring your recipes along. Then plan the week, shop from one list and cook step by step. Free to start, in any browser.

title: gethome
description_en: Smart home on a hub you own, with AI that writes the rules. Run your home from a native iPhone app on a hub you own — a small computer such as a Raspberry Pi, on your own Wi-Fi. Pair Zigbee and Matter devices, ask the assistant, and describe a rule for an AI agent to write. AI runs on your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

title: Looper
description_en: If Grok Bot drove business metrics up and was Open Source. An AI hire for one number you care about. It works daily in Gmail, GitHub, Search Console and the rest, asks your team before anything goes out, and gets a 1:1 every two weeks to improve. Open source. Runs free on the ChatGPT or Grok plan you already pay for.

title: Avatar SDK Move | Lifelike AI Motion
description_en: Turn text into hyper-realistic motion for human avatars. We all know what it means to “move like an NPC”: stiff gestures and robotic motion. Avatar SDK Move makes your avatars move like real people. Just describe an action in plain text and generate realistic animations with natural, expressive movement—no motion capture equipment required. Export animations in MetaPerson skeleton format or for Unity’s Humanoid rig via our Unity Move plugin. More export options coming soon.

title: CombienVautMonLogement
description_en: Free AI home valuations. No signup. No spam.. Discover your home's estimated value in France with AI, real estate transaction data and interactive maps. No account, no personal details, no unwanted calls. Explore local property prices, market trends and free tools. Connect with an advisor only when you choose.

title: ElderMate
description_en: AI check-in calls for parents. A short summary for you.. Your parents' morning might be your midnight. Flights, work trips or night shifts can interrupt your usual call. ElderMate makes scheduled AI check-in calls and gives you a short summary afterward. Add your own call notes, such as asking whether a parent has taken their usual medication. They simply answer their phone—no app needed. Available on iOS and Android, with 5 free calling minutes to start.

title: Spilr
description_en: Start by hearing yourself: an AI journal that asks back. Write or talk for two minutes a day. After three entries, Spilr starts building a mirror from your own words: what sets you off, the loops you repeat, and the strengths you overlook. Every insight shows the entries behind it, and you can correct it.
